content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Notion templates

Selling digital products such as Notion templates involves several layers of infrastructure, from payment processing to product delivery. Conventional platforms like Gumroad impose heavy fees—10% on every sale—while NOWPayments charges only 0.5%. This difference is crucial: for a product priced at $97, 100 sales per month would mean $921 retained with NOWPayments instead of Gumroad. Understanding this disparity is vital for maximizing your income as a digital creator.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of selling Notion templates without traditional payment platforms involves using free and open-source tools. By deploying a combination of GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for crypto payment processing, creators can create a self-sufficient ecosystem. This setup ensures that creators retain full ownership of their data and can deliver products automatically, thus streamlining the entire selling process.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators in regions where conventional payment processors are either unavailable or impose significant restrictions. Countries such as Nigeria, Ghana, and Venezuela often face these challenges, which can stifle creativity and innovation. By utilizing a sovereign commerce stack, creators can bypass these limitations, maintain complete control over their sales, and offer their products to a global audience without the burden of excessive fees.
Retain more profits by switching to NOWPayments with only a 0.5% fee.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The key components of this sovereign digital commerce stack include GitHub Pages for hosting, which is free and reliable; Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, enabling quick and efficient processing; and NOWPayments for seamless crypto transactions, offering over 300 cryptocurrencies. Together, these tools create a cohesive system that not only supports product sales but also enhances the user experience with automatic delivery and instant payment verification.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To start selling your Notion templates, first set up your hosting through GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, configure your backend using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to manage orders. Integrate NOWPayments to handle crypto payments, ensuring you choose a low-fee network. Finally, test your system to confirm that product delivery is automatic and payments are processed correctly. For a comprehensive solution, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all necessary blueprints and templates.

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by utilizing a sovereign digital commerce stack. This involves hosting your content on platforms like GitHub Pages, using backend solutions like Cloudflare Workers, and integrating NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. This architecture not only allows for full ownership but also significantly reduces transaction fees.
Achieve full ownership of your digital store without relying on third-party platforms.

This comprehensive solution is perfect for creators in regions with limited access to major payment processors. Check it out at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
